It takes a lot of courage to recognize that you might need support for past events and your current mental well-being. Wanting to see a therapist is a very positive step, and it is completely normal to feel nervous or unsure about how to bring it up with your doctor. 

When you speak with your doctor, you don't have to go into deep detail right away if you aren't comfortable. You can simply say, "I've been struggling with my mental health lately and I'd like to look into seeing a therapist. Can you help me with a referral?" If saying the words out loud feels too overwhelming, you can even write it down on a piece of paper or in your phone and hand it to them. Doctors have these conversations every day, and their main goal is to help you get the care and support you deserve.
